decision: Do the four isochoric sensitivity configurations (resolution / particle friction / confining stress / strain rate) change the round-3 verdict phi_cv = 14.3 deg << Rowe limit 28.81 deg?

alternatives.H1_shape: The 50% gap is a 2D-disc shape/kinematics effect: phi_cv stays far from 28.81 deg in every sensitivity config.
alternatives.H2_discretisation: The gap is a numerical/discretisation artefact: refining 24x48 -> 16x32 or slowing the rate moves phi_cv towards 28.81 deg.

decision_rules_predeclared.friction_monotonicity: phi_cv(mu=0.30) < phi_cv(mu=0.55) strictly; report sin(phi_cv)/mu ratio for both
decision_rules_predeclared.pressure_invariance: |phi_cv(p=200 kPa) - phi_cv(p=100 kPa)| <= 2.0 deg => pressure-independent (friction angle is a stress-ratio quantity)
decision_rules_predeclared.rate_invariance: |phi_cv(eps_dot=0.005) - phi_cv(eps_dot=0.01)| <= 2.0 deg AND inertial number < 1e-3 => rate-independent

outcome_metric: phi_cv_deg from tensordem.biaxial_critical_state.critical_state_from_stress_path(strain_measure='log', boundary_control='isochoric'), same window rule (last 20% above eps_a=0.20) as round 3
stopping_rule: one run per configuration (deterministic seed); no re-tuning of the window, tolerances, or the reference after seeing results
analysis: same analyse_isochoric.py path for all configs; no exclusions; uncertainty read from window_sensitivity spread
acknowledged_limits: single seed per config (no ensemble); phi_cv uncertainty ~ +-1.5 deg from window spread; q-drift gate remains failed for the anchor

attempt_log.outcome: all five jobs returned state=succeeded with empty artefacts (0 kB fetch) and rc=0 after ~1 minute of wall clock, i.e. they did not execute the 120 k-step runs; no stress path was produced. The sensitivity matrix is therefore NOT reported — round 4 must re-submit and the decision rules above stay unmodified.
